title: Diagnose a team, price your work, prove your skills

say: Diagnose a team, price your work, and prove your skills.
This is the video for module 3 of Agile and Scrum in Practice.
When you join a team as Scrum Master or coach, your first job is not to teach Scrum. It is to understand what is really happening, and to measure it.

panel.heading: Understand before you teach
items: Find out what is really happening
Turn opinions into numbers
Price and protect your scope
Show honest evidence

say: Then you scope and price your work so it is protected, and you build honest evidence that employers and clients can trust.

say: Ask about process. Walk me through your last Sprint. What was the Sprint Goal? Was it met?

panel.heading: Four areas to ask about
items: Process: your last Sprint, start to finish
People: when was a problem last raised?
Tools and data: show me your board
Leadership: who can add work to the team?

say: Ask about people. When did someone last raise a problem in a Retrospective, and what happened next? Listen for fear, silence or blame.

say: Ask to see the board. When was it last updated?

say: And ask who can add work, and how deadlines are set.
Ask several people separately, then watch a real Daily Scrum without speaking. Write facts, not judgements: the Daily Scrum lasted 34 minutes, not the meeting was bad.

say: Next, a scored health check. For example, Kemi is the new Scrum Master for a 7-person NGO training team in Enugu. Everyone scores eight statements from 1 to 5, anonymously, in a Google Form. We finish what we start averages just 2.14.

panel.heading: Kemi scores her team from 1 to 5

cards.d: Scores total 13. Average: 1.86, the lowest of all.
A named deputy answers daily questions; all new requests go onto the backlog first.

say: Our Product Owner is available averages 1.86. Feeling safe to raise problems averages 4.3, so safety is not the issue. Interviews show the director is often travelling, and donor requests go straight to staff.

say: With the team, Kemi agrees two experiments: a named deputy for daily questions, and all new requests go onto the backlog first. Success means both averages rise above 3 in four weeks. Share patterns, never names.

say: To set a day rate, divide the monthly income you need by the days you can really bill. For example, 1,000,000 naira over about 12 days gives a floor of about 83,000 naira a day.
Ifeoma uses 80,000 naira a day, as an illustration.

say: Midway, the client wants a second team added. Her change note: 6 extra days, 480,000 naira, signed before the work starts. That is paid work, not free scope creep.

say: Your proposal states the situation, measurable outcomes, exactly what you will do, and what is excluded, like coaching a second team.
It gives dates with a mid-point review, and fees, payment terms and how changes are handled. Writing exclusions down is what makes a change note possible later.

panel.heading: What a short proposal contains
items: Situation, in the client's words
Outcomes with measures
Activities: what, how often, with whom
Exclusions
Duration and a mid-point review
Fees, payment terms, change handling

say: Use a written agreement and invoices for every job, take a deposit from new clients, and receive payments through your business account or a processor like Paystack. Pay for certificates only on the official sites.

panel.heading: Safe payments, known scams
right: Overpay, then ask for a refund

say: Be wary of clients who overpay and ask for a refund of the difference, or who ask you to pay for software or training before they hire you. Avoid anyone who guarantees a job, sells exam dumps, or wants payment to a personal account.

say: PSM I needs only an online assessment. CSM needs a course with a Certified Scrum Trainer. Always check current fees on the official sites. To prepare, read the Scrum Guide slowly, twice.

panel.heading: Prepare for a Scrum assessment
items: Read the Scrum Guide slowly, twice
Summarise each section in one line
Repeat free practice tests
Watch for must, always and only
Quiz each other in a study group

say: Write one line per section, then take the free practice tests until you score well every time, reading every explanation.

say: Watch for trick words like must, always and only. And quiz each other in a small WhatsApp study group.

panel.rule: If the Scrum Guide does not say it, Scrum does not require it.

say: To remember. Interview, observe, then measure. Work on the lowest two areas with measured experiments. Price every option from one day rate, and control scope with signed change notes.
And show honest numbers. For example, Zainab's church youth unit raised on-time tasks from 57% to 83%. That beats any buzzword on a CV.

Honest numbers beat buzzwords

say: Your tasks: run a mini health check with a team you know, write a one-page proposal with two price options, and write your case study and 90-day plan.
